name: Francisco Assis - § 20 - Am 35
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 5a. Points out that LGBTIQ+ persons are particularly vulnerable in contexts of war and forced displacement, facing persecution and violence; calls on the Commission and the European External Action Service (EEAS) to ensure that the EU’s external aid includes protection and safeguarding measures in these contexts;
